::: {#thm-bias-exprs}
#### Bias equals expectation minus truth

$$\bias{\hth} = \E{\hth} - \theta$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\begin{aligned}
\bias{\hth}
&\eqdef \E{\erf{\hth}}
&& \text{(definition of bias)}\\
&= \E{\hth - \theta}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \E{\hth} - \E{\theta}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hth} - \theta
&& \text{($\theta$ is a constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
